changes.title: A coherent suggestion strip
changes.detail: Independent adaptive paste and Chrome capsules, quieter dismissal, matching typography and domain-only previews.

changes.title: Paste alongside typing
changes.detail: Fresh full actions survive idle prediction refreshes, then become compact beside centered words. Short accessory-only reveal. Neutral fallback restores a full action without resetting its expiry.

changes.title: Privacy and stability
changes.detail: Original clipboard preserved; Chrome clean-on-tap and expiry unchanged. Explicit incognito and Autofill transitions revoke accessories.
